items.title_en: Carnegie Mellon is putting computer science courses on YouTube for free
items.title_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学将计算机科学课程免费放到 YouTube
items.summary_en: Carnegie Mellon’s Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science is publishing free lectures on YouTube. Self-paced courseware is planned as the next step. The release gives learners access to the school’s computer science material without charge.
items.summary_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学肯尼斯·C·格里芬计算机科学学院正在 YouTube 上发布免费课程讲座。下一步计划推出可自主学习的课程材料。这将让学习者免费接触该学院的计算机科学内容。

items.title_en: Windows 11 Is Collecting Data on Which Coding Agents and Developer Tools You Use
items.title_zh: Windows 11 正收集你使用哪些编程代理和开发工具的数据
items.summary_en: Reverse engineering of Windows 11’s MissionControlAggregator found coding-agent and developer-tool usage bits in a diagnostic ETW report. The observed list includes Codex, Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Python, .NET, GCC, and Visual Studio Code executables. The finding raises questions about why a Windows system DLL records the use of these tools.
items.summary_zh: 对 Windows 11 的 MissionControlAggregator 进行逆向分析后，研究者在诊断 ETW 报告中发现了编程代理和开发工具的使用标记。相关列表包括 Codex、Claude、Copilot、Cursor，以及 Python、.NET、GCC 和 Visual Studio Code 等可执行文件。这一发现引出了一个问题：Windows 系统 DLL 为何要记录这些工具的使用情况。

items.title_en: Technical issue at JPMorgan Chase triggers online banking delays for US banks
items.title_zh: 摩根大通技术故障导致美国银行在线银行服务延迟
items.summary_en: A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase triggered online-banking delays for banks in the United States. The incident affected online banking service availability or responsiveness.
items.summary_zh: 摩根大通的一项技术故障引发了美国银行的在线银行服务延迟。该事件影响了在线银行服务的可用性或响应速度。

items.title_en: BugMeNot has closed
items.title_zh: BugMeNot 已关闭
items.summary_en: BugMeNot has closed. Its farewell thanks everyone who envisioned a better internet.
items.summary_zh: BugMeNot 已经关闭。告别信息向所有曾设想建设更好互联网的人表示感谢。

items.title_en: United Airlines experiencing a widespread system outage, airline says
items.title_zh: 联合航空发生大范围系统故障
items.summary_en: United Airlines is experiencing a widespread system outage, according to the airline. The incident affects the airline’s systems, but no further operational details are established here.
items.summary_zh: 联合航空表示，其系统正在发生大范围故障。事件影响了该航空公司的系统，但目前无法确认更多运营细节。

items.title_en: Many of Amazon’s Black Friday and Cyber Monday “deals” offered no savings
items.title_zh: 亚马逊许多黑色星期五和网络星期一“优惠”并没有省钱
items.summary_en: An investigation found that many Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals advertised by Amazon did not provide actual savings. The deals were presented as discounts even though shoppers often paid no less than usual.
items.summary_zh: 一项调查发现，亚马逊宣传的许多黑色星期五和网络星期一优惠实际上并没有带来节省。这些商品虽然以折扣形式展示，消费者实际支付的价格却往往并未降低。

items.title_en: Optimizely Compromised, Served Malware on Zoom, GitLab
items.title_zh: Optimizely 遭入侵，Zoom、GitLab 等网站被投放恶意软件
items.summary_en: On November 16, 2026, malicious JavaScript was served through Optimizely’s Web experimentation platform to visitors of 178 organizations, including Zoom, the BBC, CNN, Salesforce, GitLab, IKEA, HSBC, and others. The malware could replace cryptocurrency wallet addresses, skim payment-card data, steal cookies and screenshots, and deliver the Coruna and DarkSword iOS exploit kits on iPhones and iPads. Cryptocurrency had already been stolen in transactions verified as belonging to the attackers.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 16 日，Optimizely 的 Web 实验平台向 178 家机构的网站访客投放了恶意 JavaScript，受影响机构包括 Zoom、BBC、CNN、Salesforce、GitLab、IKEA 和 HSBC 等。该恶意软件能够替换加密货币钱包地址、窃取支付卡数据、Cookie 和屏幕截图，并在 iPhone 和 iPad 上投递 Coruna 与 DarkSword iOS 漏洞利用套件。已有加密货币在被确认属于攻击者的交易中遭窃取。

items.title_en: Software is breaking down at a systemic level
items.title_zh: 软件正在系统性崩坏
items.summary_en: The author argues that recent failures point to software problems at a systemic level. The examples cited are a two-day global Microsoft outage and an FAA ground stop that halted all flights in the United States. These events are presented as a recent combination of major technology and infrastructure disruptions.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，近期的多起故障表明软件正面临系统性问题。文章举出的例子包括持续两天的全球微软服务中断，以及导致美国所有航班停飞的 FAA 地面停飞令。这些事件被视为近期重大技术和基础设施中断的集中体现。

items.title_en: Rust changed me as a developer
items.title_zh: Rust 改变了我作为开发者的思维方式
items.summary_en: The author says programming languages can influence how software developers think, especially when a language differs substantially from what they already know. After more than six years of Rust development and over four years of professional use, the author believes Rust challenged them and changed them for the better. The experience shaped both their development habits and technical perspective.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，编程语言会影响软件开发者的思维方式，尤其是当新语言与既有经验差异很大时。作者使用 Rust 已超过六年、专业使用超过四年，并认为 Rust 带来了挑战，也让自己朝更好的方向改变。这段经历影响了作者的开发习惯和技术视角。

items.title_en: Jiff 1.0: A datetime library for Rust
items.title_zh: Jiff 1.0：Rust 的日期时间库
items.summary_en: Jiff 1.0 is a datetime library for Rust that puts time-zone handling at the center of its API. It automatically addresses many common daylight-saving-time problems and is already widely adopted in the Rust ecosystem. The name is pronounced like “gif,” with a soft “g,” as in “gem.”
items.summary_zh: Jiff 1.0 是一个 Rust 日期时间库，其 API 将时区处理置于核心位置。它会自动处理许多与夏令时有关的常见问题，并已在 Rust 生态中得到广泛采用。Jiff 的发音类似带软 g 音的“gif”，就像“gem”中的 g。

items.title_en: OpenCode Browse
items.title_zh: OpenCode Browse
items.summary_en: OpenCode Browse lets OpenCode and other MCP clients operate a user’s real browser through an MCP server and Chromium extension. Agents can open tabs, read pages, click, type, take screenshots, record tabs, and use existing logins and extensions. For logins, 2FA prompts, or payments, the tab is handed back to the user and resumes after approval.
items.summary_zh: OpenCode Browse 通过 MCP 服务器和 Chromium 扩展，让 OpenCode 及其他 MCP 客户端操作用户的真实浏览器。代理可以打开标签页、读取页面、点击、输入、截图、录制标签页，并使用现有的登录状态和扩展。在登录、双重验证或付款环节，标签页会交还给用户，获得批准后再继续操作。

items.title_en: Frame – 31.5" color ePaper display
items.title_zh: Frame：31.5 英寸彩色电子纸显示器
items.summary_en: Frame is a handmade wooden frame containing a 31.5-inch full-color ePaper display. It is the product’s third release and is now available for pre-order. The first batch is limited to about 470 units, with a few intended to ship by the end of 2026 and most deliveries expected in early 2027.
items.summary_zh: Frame 是一款采用手工木制外壳的 31.5 英寸全彩电子纸显示器。这是该产品的第三次发布，目前已开放预订。首批约 470 台，计划在 2026 年底前发出少量产品，大多数订单预计于 2027 年初交付。

items.title_en: How to Break into Security, Ptacek Edition (2012)
items.title_zh: 如何进入信息安全行业：Ptacek 版（2012）
items.summary_en: People regularly ask how to enter computer security, including career changers and IT professionals seeking to move into the field. The author asked leading security practitioners for their advice after finding his own standard answers incomplete. This is the first installment of a planned series collecting their differing perspectives.
items.summary_zh: 人们经常询问如何进入计算机安全领域，其中包括想转行的人和希望从 IT 转入安全行业的从业者。作者认为自己的固定回答不够全面，因此向多位安全领域专家征求建议。这是一个系列的第一篇，后续将汇集他们各不相同的观点。

items.title_en: How to make almost anything
items.title_zh: 如何制造几乎任何东西
items.summary_en: A project or course titled “How to make almost anything” focuses on creating a wide range of physical or electronic things. Further details about its methods or scope are not available here.
items.summary_zh: “如何制造几乎任何东西”是一项围绕制作各种实体或电子作品展开的项目或课程。现有信息未提供其具体方法或内容范围。

items.title_en: Grazing sheep in fields with solar arrays
items.title_zh: 在太阳能阵列田地放牧绵羊
items.summary_en: Two studies examine the growing practice of grazing sheep beneath solar arrays. One found that grazing at two sheep per hectare increased wild bees, honey bees, and lady beetles by 38% compared with mowing, driven mainly by an 83% rise in honey bees. The other study describes a decision-support tool to help farmers expand solar-grazing herds profitably.
items.summary_zh: 两项研究考察了在太阳能阵列下放牧绵羊这一日益普及的做法。其中一项发现，每公顷放牧两只绵羊时，野生蜜蜂、蜜蜂和瓢虫的数量比割草对照地增加 38%，主要原因是蜜蜂数量增加了 83%。另一项研究介绍了一种决策支持工具，帮助农民以盈利方式扩大太阳能牧羊规模。

items.title_en: My Quest to push native Three.js quality match AAA Game Engines
items.title_zh: 我让 Three.js 原生画质追赶 AAA 游戏引擎的探索
items.summary_en: The project measures Three.js against an indoor-scene lighting pipeline used by games. The pipeline includes lightmaps, light probes, reflection probes, screen-space reflections, screen-space global illumination, and ambient occlusion. The analysis compares what games require, what Three.js currently provides, and which parts remain to be implemented.
items.summary_zh: 该项目将 Three.js 与游戏使用的室内场景光照管线进行对比。管线包括光照贴图、光照探针、反射探针、屏幕空间反射、屏幕空间全局光照和环境光遮蔽。分析比较了游戏所需能力、Three.js 当前已有的功能，以及仍待实现的部分。

items.title_en: Chemistry is Actually Geometry
items.title_zh: 化学其实是几何学
items.summary_en: The piece is titled “Chemistry is Actually Geometry.” It presents chemistry through the lens of geometry.
items.summary_zh: 文章题为《化学其实是几何学》。它从几何学的角度看待化学。

items.title_en: What is w2rt6byl5nf1opmc-a.com?
items.title_zh: w2rt6byl5nf1opmc-a.com 是什么？
items.summary_en: A website owner noticed a new backlink from w2rt6byl5nf1opmc-a.com while demonstrating a backlink monitor to a friend. After clicking it, the owner remembered that the site could log an IP address or contain a multi-day exploit chain, and was greeted by an unexpected page.
items.summary_zh: 一位网站所有者在向朋友演示反向链接监控器时，发现 w2rt6byl5nf1opmc-a.com 突然产生了一个新链接。点击后，他意识到该网站可能记录 IP 地址，甚至包含持续数日的攻击链，随后看到了一个出乎意料的页面。

items.title_en: Pentagon fails ninth straight audit despite progress in organizing finances
items.title_zh: 尽管财务组织取得进展，美国五角大楼仍连续第九次未通过审计
items.summary_en: The Pentagon has failed its ninth consecutive audit despite making progress in organizing its finances. The audit result indicates that its financial systems still did not meet the requirements for a clean audit.
items.summary_zh: 尽管在整理财务方面取得进展，美国五角大楼仍连续第九次未通过审计。这一结果表明，其财务系统仍未达到无保留审计意见的要求。

items.title_en: Nvidia was in trouble before the Jensen Huang mess
items.title_zh: 在 Jensen Huang 的混乱之前，英伟达就已陷入困境
items.summary_en: Nvidia helped enable the AI boom, in part because its recently ousted CEO Jensen Huang invested early in chips for AI training and anticipated technological shifts. As Huang leaves and CFO Colette Kress takes over, the company faces a growing group of competitors with advanced technologies. The timing leaves Nvidia under pressure as rivals catch up.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达推动了 AI 热潮，部分原因在于其最近被免职的 CEO Jensen Huang 提前投资 AI 训练芯片，并准确预判了技术变化。随着 Huang 离任、CFO Colette Kress 接任，公司正面对一批拥有先进技术且不断壮大的竞争者。在竞争对手追赶之际，这一变化让英伟达承受更大压力。

items.title_en: Spamhaus new email sender requirements in November
items.title_zh: Spamhaus 11 月新的电子邮件发件人要求
items.summary_en: Spamhaus is gradually introducing a requirement that every sending IP have a valid HELO, a reverse-DNS PTR record, and a matching A record starting in November 2026. The guidance also covers infrastructure, authentication, list hygiene, reputation, and email service-provider requirements. Senders are expected to meet these minimum requirements to avoid being listed.
items.summary_zh: Spamhaus 将从 2026 年 11 月起逐步要求每个发件 IP 都具备有效的 HELO、反向 DNS PTR 记录以及匹配的 A 记录。其指南还涵盖基础设施、身份验证、邮件列表卫生、信誉和邮件服务商要求。发件方需要满足这些最低要求，以避免被列入黑名单。

items.title_en: Qwen4-Max
items.title_zh: Qwen4-Max
items.summary_en: Qwen4-Max is described as supporting chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool use, and artifacts. It is positioned as a model or service with functionality spanning multiple input and output types.
items.summary_zh: Qwen4-Max 被描述为支持聊天、图像和视频理解、图像生成、文档处理、联网搜索、工具调用及 artifacts。它定位为覆盖多种输入和输出形式的模型或服务。

items.title_en: Comcast's "fiber-powered Wi-Fi" is cable, AT&T says in false advertising case
items.title_zh: AT&T 在虚假广告诉讼中称，Comcast 的“光纤 Wi‑Fi”其实使用的是有线网络
items.summary_en: AT&T alleges that Comcast marketed cable internet as “fiber-powered Wi-Fi.” AT&T is seeking the profits Comcast made from that advertising.
items.summary_zh: AT&T 指控 Comcast 将有线互联网宣传为“光纤驱动的 Wi‑Fi”。AT&T 要求 Comcast 交出其通过相关广告获得的利润。

items.title_en: The Secret ThinkPad Powerbutton Code to Bring Dead Laptops Back to Life (2007)
items.title_zh: 让死机 ThinkPad 起死回生的神秘电源键代码（2007）
items.summary_en: A new Lenovo ThinkPad z61t suddenly appeared completely dead shortly before a presentation. Its sleep and battery lights were off, the machine was unusually hot, and pressing the power button or reseating the battery had no effect. The owner then called IBM support, looking for a way to bring the laptop back to life.
items.summary_zh: 一台全新的 Lenovo ThinkPad z61t 在演讲前突然完全无法启动。睡眠灯和电池灯都不亮，机器异常发热，按电源键或重新插拔电池也没有反应。机主随后致电 IBM 支持，试图找出让笔记本恢复工作的办法。

items.title_en: Whistleblower accuses Pentagon over Iran strike on US base that killed 6
items.title_zh: 举报人指控五角大楼忽视伊朗袭击美国基地的防护问题，造成 6 人死亡
items.summary_en: A US Army soldier who survived an Iranian strike on a makeshift operations center in Kuwait filed a whistleblower complaint. The strike killed six people, and the complaint alleges that the Pentagon ignored concerns about inadequate protection for troops.
items.summary_zh: 一名在伊朗袭击科威特临时行动中心中幸存的美国陆军士兵提交了举报人投诉。那次袭击造成 6 人死亡，投诉指称五角大楼没有听取有关部队防护不足的担忧。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sutra-OS – A self-hosted ontology platform
items.title_zh: Show HN：Sutra-OS——自托管本体平台
items.summary_en: Sutra-OS is an open-source, self-hosted ontology platform. It represents data as one owned model with typed and linked entities, server-enforced rules, and numbers traceable to their sources. The project describes its design as “Scarce Units, Typed, Related, Actionable.”
items.summary_zh: Sutra-OS 是一个开源、自托管的本体平台。它将数据表示为用户拥有的统一模型，其中实体具有类型和关联，修改由服务器规则强制执行，所有数字都能追溯到来源。项目将其设计概括为“稀缺、类型化、关联、可行动”。

items.title_en: Microsoft blames monster email outage on software defect introduced in July fix
items.title_zh: 微软称大规模电子邮件故障源于 7 月修复引入的软件缺陷
items.summary_en: Microsoft blamed last week’s major Microsoft 365 email outage on a defect introduced by a July 2026 change. The defect remained dormant in network gateway servers until increased load and reduced capacity triggered it, causing a day-long disruption. Microsoft’s preliminary post-incident report said the change had passed load testing and initially caused no impact after deployment.
items.summary_zh: 微软将上周 Microsoft 365 大规模电子邮件故障归因于 2026 年 7 月一次变更引入的软件缺陷。该缺陷一直潜伏在网络网关服务器中，直到负载上升、容量下降时被触发，造成持续一天的中断。微软的初步事后报告称，该变更通过了负载测试，部署后最初也没有造成影响。

items.title_en: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse
items.title_zh: 加强打击网络儿童性虐待
items.summary_en: The initiative is focused on strengthening efforts against online child sexual abuse. It concerns measures to improve online child safety and combat this form of abuse.
items.summary_zh: 该倡议旨在加强打击网络儿童性虐待的工作。其重点是改善网络儿童安全并应对这类虐待行为。

items.title_en: Universal XSS in uBlock Origin from website-driven element picker
items.title_zh: uBlock Origin 的网站驱动元素选择器存在通用 XSS
items.summary_en: A one-click universal XSS vulnerability affected the Firefox version of uBlock Origin through its element picker. A malicious website could trick the extension into adding arbitrary trusted filters, which can inject JavaScript into other websites and execute it in their contexts. The issue has been fixed; a related but less severe problem also affected the MV3-based uBO Lite.
items.summary_zh: uBlock Origin 的 Firefox 版本元素选择器存在一个可通过一次点击触发的通用 XSS 漏洞。恶意网站可以诱使扩展添加任意受信过滤规则，而受信规则能够向其他网站注入 JavaScript，并在这些网站的上下文中执行。该问题现已修复；基于 MV3 的 uBO Lite 也受到一个相关但危害较小的问题影响。

items.title_en: Running coding agents without handing them my credentials
items.title_zh: 在不给编程代理凭据的情况下运行它们
items.summary_en: The author built lend so remote coding agents can use tools on a laptop only with the user’s approval. The agents run in disposable virtual machines, while SSH keys, the 1Password vault, and authenticated GitHub and cloud CLIs remain on the laptop. The setup allows multiple agents to work while keeping sensitive credentials outside their environments.
items.summary_zh: 作者开发了 lend，让远程编程代理在获得用户批准后使用笔记本电脑上的工具。代理运行在可随时销毁的虚拟机中，而 SSH 密钥、1Password 保管库以及已登录的 GitHub 和云端 CLI 都留在笔记本电脑上。这种设置让多个代理可以并行工作，同时将敏感凭据隔离在代理环境之外。

items.title_en: Aristotle Expands into Rust
items.title_zh: Aristotle 扩展支持 Rust
items.summary_en: Aristotle is expanding its formal-verification system to Rust, following existing support for C and Verilog. It claims the tool can prove that Rust code has no undefined behavior and conforms to its specification, including code inside unsafe blocks. It can also verify behavioral equivalence when C code is rewritten in Rust.
items.summary_zh: Aristotle 正在将其形式化验证系统扩展到 Rust，此前它已支持 C 和 Verilog。该工具声称可以证明 Rust 代码不存在未定义行为并符合其规范，包括 unsafe 代码块中的代码。如果将 C 重写为 Rust，它还可以验证新代码与原代码的行为等价性。

items.title_en: Michael Mann's 'Heat' Copyright Fight Turns on a Deal with Himself
items.title_zh: 迈克尔·曼的《盗火线》版权之争，焦点在于他与自己的公司达成的协议
items.summary_en: New Regency argues that Michael Mann cannot reclaim rights to “Heat” because he wrote it for his own company. Mann counters that he wrote the early drafts independently rather than as an employee of his loan-out company. The dispute therefore turns on how those early drafts and the corporate relationship are legally characterized.
items.summary_zh: New Regency 认为，迈克尔·曼不能收回《盗火线》的版权，因为他是为自己的公司创作这部作品的。曼则表示，早期剧本是他独立创作的，并非作为其借出公司员工完成。争议因此取决于这些早期稿件及公司关系在法律上应如何认定。

items.title_en: SpaceX catches the Starship to end Flight 15
items.title_zh: SpaceX 在第 15 次飞行结束时接住星舰
items.summary_en: SpaceX's Starship Flight 15 ended with the vehicle being caught by the launch system. The available material provides no further details about the flight or the catch.
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 的星舰第 15 次飞行以发射系统接住飞行器告终。现有信息未提供这次飞行或捕获过程的更多细节。

items.title_en: Interpreting claims that a theorem is correct because it was checked in Lean
items.title_zh: 如何理解“定理已在 Lean 中检查，因此正确”的说法
items.summary_en: The post explains how to interpret claims that a theorem is correct because it was checked in Lean. It argues that Lean code provides an important signal, but AI-generated code should undergo additional tests before being trusted. The discussion notes that such tests have not yet been systematically applied to many items in OpenAI’s 722-paper theorem dump, about 45% of which included Lean code, while three non-Leanified papers were later retracted for a sign error.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章解释了应如何理解“定理已在 Lean 中检查，因此正确”这一说法。文章认为，Lean 代码确实提供了重要信号，但由 AI 生成的代码在获得信任前仍应接受额外测试。文中指出，在 OpenAI 收录 722 篇数学论文、约 45% 附带 Lean 代码的定理汇编中，这类测试尚未得到系统执行；其中三篇未 Lean 化的论文后来因符号错误被撤稿。

items.title_en: How to Intercept HTTP/3 Traffic: QUIC and Qpack
items.title_zh: 如何拦截 HTTP/3 流量：QUIC 与 QPACK
items.summary_en: HTTP/3 runs over QUIC and UDP, so conventional HTTP proxies built around TCP do not see its traffic. Interception requires a proxy that can relay UDP and act as a man in the middle for QUIC, after which requests can be examined as QPACK-compressed bytes on QUIC streams. The guide demonstrates the process with real HTTP/3 traffic from curl and Microsoft Edge and a small lab server.
items.summary_zh: HTTP/3 运行在 QUIC 和 UDP 之上，因此基于 TCP 的传统 HTTP 代理无法看到这类流量。拦截需要能够中继 UDP 并充当 QUIC 中间人的代理，之后才能检查 QUIC 流中的 QPACK 压缩字节。该指南使用 curl 和 Microsoft Edge 的真实 HTTP/3 流量，以及一个小型实验服务器演示了这一过程。

items.title_en: FBI has possession of router that the FAA says is behind Friday's ATC meltdown
items.title_zh: FBI 已取得 FAA 认为导致周五空管系统崩溃的路由器
items.summary_en: The FBI has taken possession of a router and other equipment that the FAA says were behind Friday’s air-traffic-control system meltdown. The equipment is now part of the investigation.
items.summary_zh: FBI 已取得一台路由器及其他设备，FAA 认为这些设备导致了周五的空中交通管制系统崩溃。这些设备目前已成为调查的一部分。

items.title_en: Jolt – Clojure that speaks C
items.title_zh: Jolt：会说 C 语言的 Clojure
items.summary_en: Jolt is a Clojure implementation on Scheme, using Chez natively and Gambit for JavaScript, with a Clojure-compatible standard library and no JVM. It can bind C shared libraries and expose libraries such as SQLite, Postgres, OpenSSL, and zlib. Its ahead-of-time compiler produces a self-contained executable with C dependencies linked statically.
items.summary_zh: Jolt 是构建在 Scheme 之上的 Clojure 实现，原生使用 Chez，并通过 Gambit 支持 JavaScript；它提供兼容 Clojure 的标准库且不依赖 JVM。它可以绑定 C 共享库，并以此接入 SQLite、Postgres、OpenSSL 和 zlib 等库。其提前编译器能够生成单一的自包含可执行文件，并静态链接 C 依赖。

items.title_en: What's Next for Nvidia?
items.title_zh: 英伟达的下一步是什么？
items.summary_en: Nvidia’s board announced that co-founder Jensen Huang had resigned after 33 years at the company. The change raises questions about what happens when a company loses a visionary chief executive. The supplied discussion argues that Nvidia could risk losing innovation and relying on momentum and its brand.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达董事会宣布，联合创始人黄仁勋在公司任职 33 年后辞职。这一变动引发了人们对公司失去具有远见的首席执行官后将如何发展的疑问。相关讨论认为，英伟达可能面临创新减弱、转而依赖既有势头和品牌的风险。

items.title_en: Microsoft 365 outage leads to chlorine gas poisoning of 15 hotel guests
items.title_zh: Microsoft 365 故障导致 15 名酒店客人氯气中毒
items.summary_en: A Microsoft Outlook outage meant Phantasialand did not receive notice that excessive chlorine was present in a pool. Fifteen guests were injured as a result.
items.summary_zh: 微软 Outlook 服务中断，导致 Phantasialand 未能收到泳池氯含量过高的通知。结果造成 15 名客人受伤。

items.title_en: How Billions in Safe Insurance Money Is Being Bet on A.I. Debt
items.title_zh: 数十亿美元的安全保险资金正押注于 AI 债务
items.summary_en: Insurance companies are investing billions of dollars of customers’ money in AI-related deals as analysts warn of growing risks. One example involves Elon Musk’s team creating a financial entity to borrow billions to buy AI chips and lease them back to xAI. Because xAI was not technically the borrower, the arrangement made its reported debt appear smaller to investors.
items.summary_zh: 保险公司正将客户资金中的数十亿美元投入 AI 相关交易，而分析师警告风险正在增加。一个例子是，埃隆·马斯克的团队设立金融实体，借款数十亿美元购买 AI 芯片，再将芯片回租给 xAI。由于 xAI 在技术上并非借款方，这种安排使其向投资者呈现的债务规模显得更小。

items.title_en: Coffeehouses and the Rise of Science [pdf]
items.title_zh: 咖啡馆与科学的兴起 [PDF]
items.summary_en: This PDF examines the relationship between coffeehouses and the rise of science. No further details about its argument or evidence are available here.
items.summary_zh: 这份 PDF 探讨咖啡馆与科学兴起之间的关系。现有信息未提供其论点或证据的更多细节。

items.title_en: The Active Directory Era Is Finally Over
items.title_zh: Active Directory 时代终于结束了
items.summary_en: The piece argues that Active Directory was designed for administrators managing long-lived servers and is poorly suited to tracking machine identities in modern cloud environments. It describes federation and brokering as replacements for the older identity model. Many enterprises still try to manage identities through Active Directory despite its difficulty scaling with cloud computing.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，Active Directory 是为管理长期运行服务器的管理员设计的，并不适合追踪现代云环境中的机器身份。文章将联邦和代理机制描述为旧身份模型的替代方案。尽管云计算规模化带来困难，许多企业仍在尝试通过 Active Directory 管理身份。

items.title_en: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150k DLs during data breach
items.title_zh: Uber 称黑客在数据泄露中窃取了近 15 万份驾照信息
items.summary_en: Uber said personal and driver’s-license information belonging to nearly 150,000 drivers was stolen in an October breach at Fireworks AI, one of its technology providers. The provider notified Uber on October 9 that attackers had broken in and stolen internal credentials, which were then used to access Uber’s data. Uber disclosed the incident in notices filed with several U.S. attorneys general.
items.summary_zh: Uber 表示，近 15 万名司机的个人信息和驾照信息在其技术供应商 Fireworks AI 10 月发生的数据泄露中被窃取。该供应商于 10 月 9 日通知 Uber，攻击者入侵系统并窃取了内部凭据，随后利用这些凭据访问 Uber 数据。Uber 已在提交给多州美国检察长的通知中披露此事。

items.title_en: Handwriting, as a Font
items.title_zh: 把手写字迹变成字体
items.summary_en: This browser tool turns a user’s handwriting into a font. Users write each letter in the browser and download the result as OTF or WOFF2. No account or upload is required, and the letters remain on the device.
items.summary_zh: 这个浏览器工具可以将用户的手写字迹转换为字体。用户在浏览器中书写每个字母，然后下载 OTF 或 WOFF2 格式的字体。它无需账户或上传，字母会保留在设备上。

items.title_en: Protomaps: Self-hosting map tiles has gotten cheap and easy
items.title_zh: Protomaps：自托管地图瓦片如今既便宜又简单
items.summary_en: Protomaps uses PMTiles, a tile format that stores a map in a single file and serves it through HTTP Range requests. The file can be uploaded to a storage bucket and cached by compatible CDNs, while an edge function can translate conventional x/y/z tile URLs for services such as Cloudflare. This makes map data portable and inexpensive to deploy compared with usage-priced commercial APIs.
items.summary_zh: Protomaps 使用 PMTiles，这种瓦片格式将地图存储在单个文件中，并通过 HTTP Range 请求提供服务。该文件可以上传到存储桶并由支持相关缓存的 CDN 缓存；对于 Cloudflare 等服务，也可以用边缘函数将传统的 x/y/z 瓦片 URL 转换为 Range 请求。与按使用量收费的商业 API 相比，这让地图数据更易移植，也更便宜易部署。

items.title_en: Old Bitly links are being hijacked
items.title_zh: 旧 Bitly 链接正遭劫持
items.summary_en: Burger King and McDonald’s were not hacked. Instead, someone re-registered Bitly links posted in their 2011 tweets. The same person or group has replaced 57 of 97 links in old tweets by Donald Trump.
items.summary_zh: 汉堡王和麦当劳并未遭到黑客入侵。有人重新注册了它们在 2011 年推文中使用的 Bitly 链接。同样的问题还影响了唐纳德·特朗普旧推文中的 97 个链接，其中 57 个已被替换。

items.title_en: Friselle: The ingenious Italian bread that can last for a year
items.title_zh: Friselle：一年都不会坏的巧妙意大利面包
items.summary_en: Friselle is an Italian bread presented as capable of lasting for a year. The item focuses on this bread’s unusually long shelf life.
items.summary_zh: Friselle 是一种据称可以保存一年的意大利面包。该条目聚焦于这种面包异常持久的保质期。

items.title_en: The MacBook Pro's OLED PWM problem
items.title_zh: MacBook Pro 的 OLED PWM 问题：更好的显示屏为何更难用
items.summary_en: Apple has introduced tandem OLED technology to the MacBook Pro, alongside the Mini-LED option that remains available. The display offers individually illuminated pixels, effectively infinite contrast, deeper blacks, higher peak HDR brightness, and touch input, prompting an overwhelmingly positive initial reaction. The source argues that impressive image quality does not necessarily make the screen comfortable for every user, particularly because of its PWM behavior.
items.summary_zh: 苹果为 MacBook Pro 引入了串联 OLED 技术，同时继续提供 Mini-LED 版本。该显示屏具备独立发光像素、近乎无限的对比度、更深的黑色、更高的 HDR 峰值亮度，并首次支持触控，发布初期反响普遍积极。文章指出，出色的画质并不一定意味着所有用户都能舒适使用，尤其是其 PWM 特性可能带来问题。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Axonnic (YC F26) – Sleeves that track fingers and estimate force
items.title_zh: Show HN：Axonnic——追踪手指并估算力度的袖套
items.summary_en: Axonnic has developed a forearm sleeve that uses muscle activity to decode finger movements and estimate fingertip force while leaving the hands uncovered. The sleeve has 64 surface-EMG channels and synchronizes muscle signals with hand tracking to generate training data for dexterous robots. The founders argue that EMG captures effort and subtle muscle activity that video alone cannot observe.
items.summary_zh: Axonnic 开发了一款前臂袖套，通过读取肌肉活动来解码手指动作并估算指尖力度，同时保持双手裸露。袖套配备 64 个表面肌电通道，并将肌肉信号与手部追踪同步，用于生成灵巧机器人训练数据。创始人认为，肌电信号能够捕捉视频无法单独观察到的用力程度和细微肌肉活动。

items.title_en: Tor Project Issues Rapid-Response DoS-Defense Fix Amid Sustained DDoS Attack
items.title_zh: Tor 项目在持续 DDoS 攻击下紧急发布防 DoS 修复
items.summary_en: The Tor Project released version 0.4.9.17 with a series of security fixes. One particularly important change improves relay defenses against denial-of-service attacks related to IPv6 handling. The rapid-response release follows an ongoing DDoS attack that has affected most relay operators.
items.summary_zh: Tor 项目发布了 0.4.9.17 版本，其中包含一系列安全修复。其中一项重要改动改进了中继节点针对 IPv6 处理相关拒绝服务攻击的防护。此次快速响应发布源于一场仍在持续的 DDoS 攻击，该攻击已影响大多数中继运营者。

items.title_en: Squircles
items.title_zh: 圆方形
items.summary_en: A squircle is a shape between a square and a circle, with no single mathematical definition. Different curves can represent squircles, and they can vary continuously between circular and square forms. The superellipse is the best-known example, popularized by Piet Hein.
items.summary_zh: “圆方形”是介于正方形和圆形之间的一类形状，并没有唯一的数学定义。不同曲线都可以构成圆方形，其形态能够在圆形与方形之间变化。最著名的例子是由 Piet Hein 推广的超椭圆。

items.title_en: Debian Becomes Unresponsive after 6.1.0-55 Kernel Update
items.title_zh: Debian 在 6.1.0-55 内核更新后停止响应
items.summary_en: A Debian system becomes unresponsive after updating to kernel version 6.1.0-55. The report concerns a regression or compatibility problem associated with that kernel update.
items.summary_zh: 一台 Debian 系统在更新至 6.1.0-55 版内核后停止响应。该报告涉及与此次内核更新相关的回归或兼容性问题。

items.title_en: Crows make decisions faster than we can
items.title_zh: “鸟脑”是个误称：乌鸦做决定比人类更快
items.summary_en: In a recent experiment, crows processed and responded to visual cues at twice the speed of humans and monkeys. The study, published in Science, provides a first quantitative measure of the neural speed of avian decision-making. The results show that the crows outperformed both human and nonhuman primate participants.
items.summary_zh: 在一项近期实验中，乌鸦处理并回应视觉线索的速度是人类和猴子的两倍。这项发表于《科学》的研究首次量化了鸟类决策的神经速度。结果显示，乌鸦的表现超过了人类和非人类灵长类参与者。

items.title_en: Show HN: 1.499x speedup and 28.5% dynamic energy drop on A40 via BF16 tiling
items.title_zh: Show HN：通过 BF16 分块在 A40 上提速 1.499 倍并降低 28.5% 动态能耗
items.summary_en: The project reports a 1.499× speedup and a 28.5% reduction in dynamic energy on an NVIDIA A40 using BF16 tiling. The supplied benchmark context identifies the GPU as an Ampere A40 with 48 GB of GDDR6 memory and a 300 W TDP. The authors provide raw benchmark outputs and methodology materials for civilian, academic, and commercial research.
items.summary_zh: 该项目报告称，通过 BF16 分块技术，NVIDIA A40 上的性能提升了 1.499 倍，动态能耗降低了 28.5%。基准测试使用的是 Ampere 架构 A40，配备 48 GB GDDR6 显存和 300 W TDP。作者提供了原始基准输出和方法材料，供民用、学术及商业研究使用。

items.title_en: A short explainer on how El Niño works [video]
items.title_zh: 简明视频解释厄尔尼诺如何运作
items.summary_en: A short video explains how El Niño works.
items.summary_zh: 一段简短视频解释了厄尔尼诺现象如何运作。

items.title_en: The Weather at Home
items.title_zh: 家中的天气
items.summary_en: The author built Field Guide, a local website that describes current outdoor conditions in plain sentences. It uses readings from a Tempest weather station connected to Home Assistant and replaces a standard WeeWX dashboard of gauges, tables, and summaries. The site is accessible only from the home network or through Tailscale.
items.summary_zh: 作者构建了 Field Guide，这是一个用普通句子描述当前室外状况的本地网站。它使用连接到 Home Assistant 的 Tempest 气象站数据，取代了由仪表盘、表格和汇总组成的标准 WeeWX 页面。该网站只能通过家庭网络或 Tailscale 访问。

items.title_en: Preserving 30 years of Salon journalism
items.title_zh: 保存 Salon 30 年的新闻报道
items.summary_en: Salon launched in 1995 as one of the first major publications born on the internet, covering politics, culture, criticism, and ideas. After 31 years, Salon has announced that it is ceasing publication. Web archiving will preserve its stories so they do not disappear.
items.summary_zh: Salon 于 1995 年创办，是最早诞生于互联网的主要出版物之一，内容涵盖政治、文化、评论和思想。经过 31 年运营后，Salon 宣布将停止出版。网络存档将保存这些报道，使其不至于消失。

items.title_en: First phase of embedded assessments at OpenAI
items.title_zh: OpenAI 嵌入式评估的第一阶段
items.summary_en: OpenAI has begun the first phase of its embedded assessments. The initiative concerns embedding assessments into its systems or workflows.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 已启动嵌入式评估的第一阶段。该计划涉及将评估机制嵌入其系统或工作流程。

items.title_en: A 512 KiB binary message teaching chess without a shared language
items.title_zh: 一条 512 KiB 的二进制消息：无需共享语言也能教会国际象棋
items.summary_en: Golden Board is a 512 KiB binary message designed to teach chess to a recipient with no shared language, culture, or prior knowledge. It first explains how to read its own binary format, then presents images, rules, visual lessons, and 64 complete games. The project’s code and documentation are available publicly.
items.summary_zh: Golden Board 是一条 512 KiB 的二进制消息，旨在向一个没有共同语言、文化或先验知识的接收者教授国际象棋。它先解释如何读取自身的二进制格式，然后提供图片、规则、可视化课程和 64 盘完整棋局。项目代码和文档已公开。

items.title_en: ChatGPT Wallet
items.title_zh: ChatGPT Wallet
items.summary_en: ChatGPT Wallet is a product or feature associated with ChatGPT. Further details about its purpose or operation are not available here.
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT Wallet 是与 ChatGPT 相关的一项产品或功能。现有信息未提供其用途或运作方式的更多细节。

items.title_en: WebGL Flight Simulator with seed generated terrain
items.title_zh: 使用种子生成地形的 WebGL 飞行模拟器
items.summary_en: This free browser game lets players take off, explore a procedurally generated world, and land safely. Players can choose a biplane, turboprop, or jet in the hangar. It is built with DAI Studio.
items.summary_zh: 这款免费的浏览器游戏允许玩家起飞、探索程序生成的世界，并安全降落。玩家可以在机库中选择双翼机、涡桨飞机或喷气式飞机。游戏使用 DAI Studio 构建。

items.title_en: Psychic: Like fzf but learns from your actions
items.title_zh: Psychic：像 fzf 一样，但会从你的操作中学习
items.summary_en: Psychic is a terminal-based file browser that tracks visited directories and opened files. It trains a lightweight machine-learning model on the user’s activity to rank likely results and update them as the user types. The interface is designed to render in under 16 milliseconds.
items.summary_zh: Psychic 是一个终端文件浏览器，会记录用户访问过的目录和打开过的文件。它使用用户的操作训练轻量级机器学习模型，以此对可能的结果排序，并在输入时实时更新。其界面设计目标是将渲染时间控制在 16 毫秒以内。

items.title_en: Winudf – DVD / BluRay driver for DOS, Windows 1.x – 3x / 95 / 98 / ME
items.title_zh: Winudf：适用于 DOS、Windows 1.x–3.x、95、98、ME 的 DVD/Blu-ray 驱动
items.summary_en: WINUDF is an installable file-system driver that lets DOS and early Windows systems read and write UDF media. It supports UDF versions 1.02 through 2.60, including DVDs, Blu-ray discs, packet-written CDs, and UDF-formatted USB drives. DOS and Windows 1.0x–3.11 receive drive letters through WINUDF.EXE, while WINUDF.VXD provides a long-name file-system driver for Windows 95, 98, and ME.
items.summary_zh: WINUDF 是一种可安装文件系统驱动，让 DOS 和早期 Windows 系统能够读写 UDF 媒体。它支持 1.02 至 2.60 版 UDF，涵盖 DVD、蓝光光盘、包写入 CD 以及采用 UDF 格式的 USB 驱动器。DOS 和 Windows 1.0x–3.11 可通过 WINUDF.EXE 获得盘符，Windows 95、98 和 ME 则使用支持长文件名的 WINUDF.VXD 驱动。

items.title_en: Beyond Floating Point: Next-Generation Computer Arithmetic
items.title_zh: 超越浮点数：下一代计算机算术
items.summary_en: The talk presents posits, a numerical data type designed as a possible replacement for IEEE 754 floating-point numbers. Posits are described as offering larger dynamic range, higher accuracy, simpler exception handling, and no infinity or NaN values, while scaling from two-bit operands to thousands of bits. The design could allow chips, particularly GPUs, to perform more arithmetic per watt with less silicon than comparable floating-point hardware.
items.summary_zh: 演讲介绍了 posit，一种旨在替代 IEEE 754 浮点数的数据类型。Posit 被描述为具有更大的动态范围、更高精度和更简单的异常处理机制，并且不会出现无穷大或 NaN，同时可从 2 位操作数扩展到数千位。与类似的浮点硬件相比，这种设计可能让芯片，尤其是 GPU，以更少的硅面积实现更高的每瓦计算量。

items.title_en: New James Bond Announced and the Name's Pattinson, Robert Pattinson
items.title_zh: 新任詹姆斯·邦德公布：罗伯特·帕丁森
items.summary_en: Robert Pattinson has been announced as Daniel Craig’s successor in the James Bond franchise. He will become the seventh actor to play 007 in an official Bond film after a lengthy casting process.
items.summary_zh: 罗伯特·帕丁森已被宣布为詹姆斯·邦德系列中 Daniel Craig 的继任者。经过漫长的选角过程后，他将成为第七位在官方邦德电影中饰演 007 的演员。

items.title_en: Actual Curl Rewrites in Rust
items.title_zh: 真正用 Rust 重写 curl
items.summary_en: The long-standing idea of rewriting curl in Rust has often been treated as a joke or a serious challenge. The author says recent AI capabilities have made it possible for someone to demonstrate such a rewrite. The piece presents an actual Rust rewrite rather than merely revisiting the idea.
items.summary_zh: 长期以来，用 Rust 重写 curl 的想法既常被当作玩笑，也被视为严肃挑战。作者表示，近期的 AI 能力让人们终于能够展示这样的重写成果。文章介绍的是实际的 Rust 重写，而不只是再次讨论这一设想。

items.title_en: Claude Mythos slashed software work to onboard AMD GPUs to around three days
items.title_zh: Claude Mythos 将 AMD GPU 软件适配工作压缩到约三天
items.summary_en: Anthropic says its Claude Mythos Preview brought one model’s prompt processing to AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs in about three days. The claim suggests that AI-generated low-level code could reduce the software work required to support non-Nvidia accelerators. It also bears on the role of CUDA in the GPU software ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，Claude Mythos Preview 用约三天时间让一个模型的提示词处理运行在 AMD Instinct MI355X GPU 上。这一说法表明，AI 生成的底层代码可能减少支持非英伟达加速器所需的软件工作量。它也涉及 CUDA 在 GPU 软件生态中的作用。

items.title_en: Emacs Is My Browser
items.title_zh: Emacs 是我的浏览器
items.summary_en: The author has been using Emacs's EWW text-based browser more seriously as part of an effort to make Emacs the sole computing environment. After several days, EWW appeared sufficient for roughly 85–90% of browsing tasks, including many JavaScript-heavy sites. The author also says that EWW and other terminal browsers reduce the distractions and endless browsing loops common in modern graphical browsers.
items.summary_zh: 为了让 Emacs 成为唯一的计算环境，作者开始更认真地使用其文本浏览器 EWW。经过几天使用，作者认为 EWW 足以应对大约 85% 至 90% 的浏览需求，包括许多 JavaScript 密集型网站。作者还表示，EWW 及其他终端浏览器能减少现代图形浏览器中常见的干扰和无休止的浏览循环。

items.title_en: Show HN: Open-source, real-time object tracking for live video feeds
items.title_zh: Show HN：面向实时视频流的开源目标追踪
items.summary_en: tamserve runs Meta’s SAM 3 on live camera feeds, using it to detect named objects every few frames and EdgeTAM to track them between detections. On an RTX 4090, it reports tracking arbitrary named objects four times faster than SAM 3’s tracker at 92% of its accuracy, while tracking people across 16 cameras with lower GPU use. Its memory remained flat at 3.5 GB on a 3,000-frame video, whereas SAM 3 ran out of memory at frame 423.
items.summary_zh: tamserve 在实时摄像头画面上运行 Meta 的 SAM 3，每隔数帧检测用户指定的目标，并使用 EdgeTAM 在检测之间持续追踪。在 RTX 4090 上，它声称对任意指定目标的追踪速度是 SAM 3 追踪器的 4 倍，同时达到其 92% 的准确率；追踪人物时可同时处理 16 个摄像头，GPU 使用量更低。在 3,000 帧视频上，它的内存占用保持在 3.5 GB，而 SAM 3 在第 423 帧耗尽内存。

items.title_en: It's always DNS, so why are we running our own?
items.title_zh: 总是 DNS 出问题，那我们为什么还要自己运行？
items.summary_en: S2 replaced Route53 with its own authoritative DNS server after deciding to remove a limit of 100 basins per account. Each customer basin becomes a subdomain such as my-basin.b.s2.dev, with a CNAME routing clients to the correct cell. Supporting unlimited basins therefore required the company to support an unlimited number of DNS records.
items.summary_zh: S2 决定取消每个账户 100 个 basin 的限制后，用自建权威 DNS 服务器替换了 Route53。每个客户 basin 都会成为一个子域名，例如 my-basin.b.s2.dev，并通过 CNAME 将客户端路由到正确的架构单元。因此，要支持不限数量的 basin，就必须支持不限数量的 DNS 记录。

items.title_en: Clice v1.0 Released: Welcome to Modern C++
items.title_zh: Clice 1.0 发布：欢迎来到现代 C++
items.summary_en: Clice has reached its first stable release after surpassing 1,000 commits and undergoing about four months of alpha testing since July 19, 2026. The project’s author reports extensive testing across open-source projects and says its core features are now stable for everyday use. The release follows two and a half years of development.
items.summary_zh: Clice 在提交数超过 1,000 次、并自 2026 年 7 月 19 日起经历约四个月 alpha 测试后，发布了首个稳定版本。项目作者表示，它已在多个开源项目上进行了广泛测试，核心功能现已适合日常使用。此次发布源于两年半的开发工作。

items.title_en: Kubernetes Is Strengthening Its Position as the AI Platform of Choice
items.title_zh: Kubernetes 正巩固其作为首选 AI 平台的地位
items.summary_en: The supplied material says that Kubernetes-related improvements extend beyond a single release and are also arriving through Karpenter. It frames these developments as part of Kubernetes’s broader role in AI infrastructure. No additional concrete release details are provided.
items.summary_zh: 现有材料指出，Kubernetes 的改进并不局限于单次发布，Karpenter 也在带来其他重要变化。这些发展被视为 Kubernetes 在 AI 基础设施中更广泛作用的一部分。材料未提供更多具体的版本或功能细节。

items.title_en: Eclipse Mosquitto – An open source MQTT broker
items.title_zh: Eclipse Mosquitto：开源 MQTT 代理
items.summary_en: Eclipse Mosquitto is an open-source implementation of an MQTT broker supporting MQTT versions 5.0, 3.1.1, and 3.1. It also provides C and C++ client libraries and command-line tools for publishing, subscribing, and administering the broker.
items.summary_zh: Eclipse Mosquitto 是一个开源 MQTT 代理实现，支持 MQTT 5.0、3.1.1 和 3.1 版本。它还提供 C 和 C++ 客户端库，以及用于发布、订阅和管理代理的命令行工具。

items.title_en: Mini.nvim Is Now on Tangled
items.title_zh: Mini.nvim 现已登陆 Tangled
items.summary_en: Mini.nvim is a library of more than 45 independent Lua modules for improving the Neovim experience with minimal effort. The modules target Neovim 0.10 and later and share common configuration approaches and design principles.
items.summary_zh: Mini.nvim 是一个包含 45 个以上独立 Lua 模块的库，旨在以尽可能少的配置改善 Neovim 使用体验。这些模块面向 Neovim 0.10 及更高版本，并采用统一的配置方式和设计原则。

items.title_en: Do Repeat Yourself
items.title_zh: 重复自己也有道理
items.summary_en: The piece argues that repetition can be beneficial in software design. It uses two teams building similar banking features with different languages and front ends to illustrate how service-oriented architectures let teams work in their preferred ways. The examples include filtering and queries, charts, and CSV/PDF exports.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，在软件设计中重复有时是有益的。它以两个团队开发相似银行功能、但采用不同语言和前端技术为例，说明面向服务的架构如何让团队按照各自擅长的方式工作。示例功能包括筛选与查询、图表以及 CSV/PDF 导出。

items.title_en: Skydio's asymmetrical F10 Lightrunner solves a problem with fixed-wing drones
items.title_zh: Skydio 不对称 F10 Lightrunner 解决固定翼无人机难题
items.summary_en: Skydio’s F10 Lightrunner uses an asymmetrical design and a wingtip-mounted camera to improve aerial vision and reduce blind spots. The autonomously operated, high-speed fixed-wing drone is designed to provide higher-quality video than other fixed-wing drones.
items.summary_zh: Skydio 的 F10 Lightrunner 采用不对称设计和翼尖摄像头，以改善空中视野并减少盲区。这款自主运行的高速固定翼无人机旨在提供高于其他固定翼无人机的视频质量。

items.title_en: Elementary Applied Topology, 2nd Ed by Robert Ghrist [pdf]
items.title_zh: 《基础应用拓扑学》第二版，Robert Ghrist 著
items.summary_en: The second edition of Robert Ghrist’s “Elementary Applied Topology” is available as a PDF. It is an introductory work on applied topology.
items.summary_zh: Robert Ghrist 所著《基础应用拓扑学》第二版已提供 PDF 版本。这是一本介绍应用拓扑学的入门著作。

items.title_en: Parcel: A desktop mail client for Linux, built with Zig
items.title_zh: Parcel：使用 Zig 构建的 Linux 桌面邮件客户端
items.summary_en: Parcel is a Linux desktop mail client for Gmail and Fastmail. It is built with Zig and siv.
items.summary_zh: Parcel 是一款面向 Linux 桌面的 Gmail 和 Fastmail 邮件客户端。它使用 Zig 和 siv 构建。

items.title_en: Show HN: OpenTodo – a self-hosted, local-first task manager in one Go binary
items.title_zh: Show HN：OpenTodo——单个 Go 二进制文件实现的自托管、本地优先任务管理器
items.summary_en: OpenTodo is a free, open-source task manager that can be self-hosted or hosted for users. It works on phones and computers, supports offline use and shared lists, and keeps users’ data under their control. The project is designed as a local-first alternative to subscription-based task applications.
items.summary_zh: OpenTodo 是一款免费开源的任务管理器，用户可以自行部署或交由他人托管。它支持手机和电脑、离线使用以及与家人或团队共享列表，并让用户掌控自己的数据。该项目旨在提供一种本地优先的替代方案，减少对订阅制任务应用的依赖。

items.title_en: Google: AI agent turned a security patch into a exploit with no human help
items.title_zh: Google：AI 代理在无人协助下将安全补丁变成了漏洞利用程序
items.summary_en: Google Threat Intelligence Group said a suspected Russian-speaking operator used an AI agent to turn security patches into working exploits without human involvement. The operation ultimately stole data from victim organizations, and Google described it as a major advance over the previous quarter in autonomous vulnerability discovery and exploitation.
items.summary_zh: Google 威胁情报部门表示，一名疑似讲俄语的操作者使用 AI 代理，在无人参与的情况下将安全补丁转化为可用的漏洞利用程序。该行动最终从受害组织窃取了数据；Google 称，与上一季度相比，这代表攻击者在自主发现和利用漏洞方面取得了显著进展。

items.title_en: Atomic Nuked Veteran
items.title_zh: 原子弹爆炸幸存老兵
items.summary_en: A post about an “Atomic Nuked Veteran” questions how applicants qualify for a related license plate. The discussion jokingly asks whether eligibility is verified with a Geiger counter, while the available excerpt does not provide the actual verification process.
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于“原子弹爆炸幸存老兵”的文章讨论相关车牌申请人如何证明资格。讨论开玩笑地问是否会用盖革计数器进行验证，但现有摘录没有说明实际审核方式。

items.title_en: Researchers track whole body movement with just a smartwatch
items.title_zh: 研究人员仅用一块智能手表追踪全身运动
items.summary_en: Cornell researchers developed EchoMotion, a system that tracks a person’s entire body using ultrasonic sound from an off-the-shelf smartwatch and a lightweight AI model. It uses the watch’s built-in speaker and microphone in a sonar-like setup to determine body position while preserving privacy and efficiency. Integrated into wearables or VR systems, it could support workout tracking, activity monitoring, and physical rehabilitation.
items.summary_zh: 康奈尔大学研究人员开发了 EchoMotion，利用普通智能手表发出的超声波和轻量级 AI 模型追踪人的全身运动。系统通过手表内置扬声器和麦克风构成类似声呐的感知方案，以确定身体姿态，同时兼顾隐私和效率。集成到可穿戴设备或 VR 系统后，它可用于记录锻炼、监测日常活动和辅助物理康复。

items.title_en: OOS – an open operating system for the Rigol Scopes
items.title_zh: OOS：面向 Rigol 示波器的开放操作系统
items.summary_en: OOS is presented as an open operating system for Rigol oscilloscopes. The available page is a forum thread with little additional technical detail.
items.summary_zh: OOS 被介绍为一款面向 Rigol 示波器的开放操作系统。现有页面是一个论坛主题，未提供更多技术细节。

items.title_en: Do we still have to denormalize? Have your schema and search it too
items.title_zh: 我们还需要反规范化吗？让数据库模式与搜索兼得
items.summary_en: ParadeDB describes ways to accelerate search and aggregate joins across normalized PostgreSQL schemas. The approach combines DataFusion, Rank Joins, co-partitioning, and tuple tagging. The challenge is that search across related tables such as users, posts, and comments is harder to optimize than search over one denormalized table.
items.summary_zh: ParadeDB 介绍了如何加速规范化 PostgreSQL 模式上的搜索和聚合连接。其方法结合了 DataFusion、Rank Joins、共同分区和元组标记。难点在于，跨 users、posts 和 comments 等关联表搜索，比在单个反规范化表中搜索更难优化。

items.title_en: Formal Verification Is Not Verifiable
items.title_zh: 形式化验证并不可验证
items.summary_en: The author argues that AI has helped bring formal verification into the mainstream. Writing in December 2025, the author said that developments over the preceding year made that conclusion difficult to dispute.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，人工智能已经推动形式化验证走向主流。作者在 2025 年 12 月写道，过去一年发生的发展让这一判断很难再被否认。文章进一步探讨了标题所指向的局限。

items.title_en: A quest to create the perfect whiskey glass
items.title_zh: 打造完美威士忌酒杯的探索
items.summary_en: Austrian designer Kurt Josef Zalto has created the No. 11 whiskey glass for Josephinenhütte after three years of research. The design aims to prevent alcohol from overpowering the whiskey’s aroma. Zalto grew up accompanying his fifth-generation glassmaker father in the workshop.
items.summary_zh: 奥地利设计师 Kurt Josef Zalto 为 Josephinenhütte 设计了 No. 11 威士忌酒杯，历时三年研究。该设计旨在避免酒精气味压过威士忌的香气。Zalto 从小便跟随家族第五代玻璃工匠父亲进入工坊。

items.title_en: Artificial Intelligence for the Z80
items.title_zh: 面向 Z80 的人工智能
items.summary_en: This project teaches AI by implementing algorithms, data structures, and neural networks from scratch in BASIC. It uses 8-bit computers such as the Z80, the Spectrum, and the Spectrum Next as a practical laboratory for exploring AI concepts and history.
items.summary_zh: 该项目通过用 BASIC 从头实现算法、数据和神经网络来学习人工智能。它将 Z80、Spectrum 和 Spectrum Next 等 8 位计算机作为实践实验室，用于探索 AI 的概念与发展历史。

items.title_en: Smallest possible nopert polyhedra: the Septopert
items.title_zh: 最小的非鲁珀特多面体：Septopert
items.summary_en: The Septopert is a convex seven-vertex polyhedron that is not Rupert, meaning it cannot pass through a congruent copy of itself. Seven vertices is the minimum possible for a non-Rupert polyhedron. The page gives exact statements, Lean-checked proofs, and reproduction instructions for the canonical Septopert.
items.summary_zh: Septopert 是一种拥有 7 个顶点、且不是鲁珀特多面体的凸多面体，也就是说它无法穿过与自身全等的另一个多面体。7 个顶点是非鲁珀特多面体可能达到的最少数量。页面提供了规范 Septopert 的精确陈述、经 Lean 检查的证明和复现步骤。

items.title_en: Notes on Mathematics for Engineers (1959) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 工程师数学笔记（1959 年）
items.summary_en: A 1959 PDF contains mathematics notes for engineers.
items.summary_zh: 这份 1959 年的 PDF 包含面向工程师的数学笔记。

items.title_en: Simple 8085 Computer
items.title_zh: 简单的 8085 计算机
items.summary_en: This project builds a simple 8-bit computer around the Intel 8085, running at 4.9 MHz with 8 KB each of ROM and RAM. It includes a small BASIC interpreter, a monitor program, and one I/O port for interfacing.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目围绕 Intel 8085 构建了一台运行频率为 4.9 MHz 的简单 8 位计算机，配备各 8 KB 的 ROM 和 RAM。它内置精简版 BASIC、监控程序，以及一个用于连接外设的 I/O 端口。

items.title_en: The Lasting Influence of John Berger
items.title_zh: 约翰·伯格的持久影响
items.summary_en: John Berger’s television series “Ways of Seeing” popularized a Marxist perspective on art and made him widely known. In his centennial year, his diverse body of work continues to inspire and provoke reactions. Merve Emre’s review of Tom Overton’s biography surveys Berger’s life and his work as an art critic, novelist, and cultural figure.
items.summary_zh: 约翰·伯格的电视系列节目《观看之道》普及了马克思主义艺术观，也让他广为人知。在他诞辰一百周年之际，他多样化的作品仍持续引发启发与争议。Merve Emre 对 Tom Overton 所著传记的评论，回顾了伯格作为艺术评论家、小说家和文化人物的一生及其创作。

items.title_en: Making Atuin sync 32x faster with packfiles
items.title_zh: 使用 packfile 让 Atuin 同步速度提升 32 倍
items.summary_en: Atuin’s 18.20.0 release makes synchronization 32 times faster for its hosted service and 16 times faster for self-hosted users. It can now sync many thousands of records in single-digit seconds by packaging records into encrypted packfiles, pipelining downloads, and batching SQL inserts. The packfiles use the same PASETO-based encryption as individual records, and the sync protocol version did not need to change.
items.summary_zh: Atuin 18.20.0 版本让其托管服务的同步速度提升了 32 倍，自托管用户的同步速度提升了 16 倍。通过将记录打包为加密 packfile、流水线式下载并批量执行 SQL 插入，它现在可以在个位数秒内同步数千条记录。packfile 与单条记录使用相同的基于 PASETO 的加密方式，而且无需升级同步协议版本。

items.title_en: Exact Gradients Through a BRep Kernel
items.title_zh: 通过 BRep 内核计算精确梯度
items.summary_en: The vcad BRep kernel differentiates CAD parameters, including fillet radii, through tessellation while keeping the mesh topology fixed. It uses analytic surfaces, implicit differentiation, and tangency constraints, and was checked against finite differences from fresh rebuilds. The method also supports directional second derivatives, reverse-mode passes, mass properties, and a rigid-body adjoint with penalty contact, while topology changes remain a separate issue.
items.summary_zh: vcad 的 BRep 内核在固定网格拓扑的情况下，通过曲面离散化计算包括圆角半径在内的 CAD 参数梯度。它结合解析曲面、隐式微分和相切约束，并通过重新构建模型后的有限差分进行校验。该方法还支持方向二阶导数、反向传播、质量属性以及带惩罚接触的刚体伴随计算，但拓扑变化仍是另一个问题。

items.title_en: Show HN: ThingStudio, Node-RED style programming for microcontrollers
items.title_zh: Show HN：ThingStudio，用于微控制器的 Node-RED 风格编程
items.summary_en: ThingStudio is a local, Apache 2-licensed visual programming environment for microcontrollers. Users build programs with drag-and-drop flows similar to Node-RED, while the tool generates MicroPython and uploads it to the device; the board runs independently afterward. Installation is required for uploading because WebSerial support is not universal.
items.summary_zh: ThingStudio 是一款本地运行、采用 Apache 2 许可证的微控制器可视化编程环境。用户可以像使用 Node-RED 一样拖放流程，工具则生成 MicroPython 并上传到设备，之后开发板无需编辑器即可运行。由于 WebSerial 支持并不普遍，上传功能需要安装软件。

items.title_en: The origins of the placenta
items.title_zh: 胎盘的起源
items.summary_en: Caltech biologists produced a detailed view of implantation in mouse embryos by filming embryos and tracking gene activity in more than 22,000 individual cells. They found that the placenta has a second cellular source: a small number of cells from the opposite side of the embryo migrate to help build it. Removing those cells prevented the structure that gives rise to the placenta from forming.
items.summary_zh: 加州理工学院生物学家通过拍摄小鼠胚胎着床过程，并追踪超过 22,000 个单细胞中的基因活动，绘制了详细图景。他们发现，胎盘还有第二个细胞来源：来自胚胎另一侧的少量细胞会迁移过去，参与胎盘构建。移除这些细胞后，原本会发育成胎盘的结构无法形成。

items.title_en: Nature-Based Sanitation. Cihuatlán: A Large-Scale Artificial Wetland
items.title_zh: 自然基础卫生设施：Cihuatlán 的大型人工湿地
items.summary_en: The project concerns nature-based sanitation in Cihuatlán through a large-scale constructed wetland. Further details about its design or results are not available here.
items.summary_zh: 该项目关注在 Cihuatlán 通过大型人工湿地实现基于自然的卫生处理。现有信息未提供其设计或效果的更多细节。

items.title_en: The Opportunivore's Dilemma
items.title_zh: 机会主义杂食者的困境
items.summary_en: After an SUV struck two elk near Yellowstone, local resident Brian Ertel helped the shaken but unharmed driver escape the wreck and secured the scene with arriving responders and students. One elk was dead and the other mortally wounded, so Ertel used a copper-jacketed bullet to end the injured animal’s suffering while avoiding lead contamination. The episode sets up a broader account of wildlife, roads, and human responses to animals near developed areas.
items.summary_zh: 一辆 SUV 在黄石国家公园附近撞上两只麋鹿后，当地居民 Brian Ertel 帮助受惊但未受伤的司机脱离残骸，并与赶到的救援人员和学生一起控制现场。一只麋鹿当场死亡，另一只伤势致命；Ertel 使用铜制弹头结束了受伤动物的痛苦，以避免铅污染。这一事件引出了对野生动物、道路以及人类如何应对出现在开发区域附近的动物的更广泛叙述。

items.title_en: New open source C4 Diagram tool
items.title_zh: 新的开源 C4 图表工具
items.summary_en: A new open-source tool for creating C4 diagrams has been released. It is intended for documenting software architecture using the C4 model.
items.summary_zh: 一款新的开源 C4 图表工具已经发布。它用于使用 C4 模型记录软件架构。

items.title_en: Expozine at 25: Has the Independent Print Scene Outgrown Expozine?
items.title_zh: Expozine 迎来 25 周年：独立印刷界是否已经超越 Expozine？
items.summary_en: At its 25th edition, Montreal’s Expozine rejected nearly 40% of applicants while ARCMTL launched an online catalogue making more than 10,000 zines easier to find. The fair continues to showcase artists and Montreal’s independent arts and literary culture. Its growth raises questions about how to accommodate an expanding community and preserve its printed artifacts for future generations.
items.summary_zh: 蒙特利尔 Expozine 第 25 届活动拒绝了近 40% 的申请者；与此同时，ARCMTL 推出在线目录，让超过 10,000 本 zine 更容易被找到。该展会继续展示艺术家作品以及蒙特利尔的独立艺术和文学文化。它的发展也引出了如何容纳不断扩大的社群，以及如何为后代保存这些印刷品的问题。

items.title_en: Eight years of running DocSpring on Convox
items.title_zh: 在 Convox 上运行 DocSpring 的八年
items.summary_en: DocSpring has run on Convox, a Heroku-like PaaS deployed in a customer’s own AWS account, since 2018. The author describes lessons about deployments, Terraform, maintenance, compliance, and AWS costs after migrating from Heroku. Convox provided an application platform out of the box while allowing the team to gradually take over and adapt its Terraform configuration.
items.summary_zh: DocSpring 自 2018 年起一直运行在 Convox 上。Convox 是部署于用户自有 AWS 账户中的 Heroku 式 PaaS。作者总结了从 Heroku 迁移后在部署、Terraform、维护、合规和 AWS 成本方面的经验；Convox 提供了开箱即用的平台，同时让团队逐步接管并调整 Terraform 配置。
